context: Tests the narrow signed-API fallback for a non-Go Homebrew publisher that lacks native GitHub App commit signing.

checklist.name: Durable release gate
checklist.description: The tap job resolves an exact trusted tag, requires a published immutable release that passes gh release verify, and can repair missing tap parity on a later run without relying solely on new_release_published.

checklist.name: Scoped App token
checklist.description: Source Release state is read with the source workflow token; the write token is a separate short-lived App token naming only homebrew-tap with Contents write.

checklist.name: Safe tap checkout
checklist.description: The tap checkout targets main, uses the App token, and sets persist-credentials: false.

checklist.name: Narrow deterministic generation
checklist.description: Generation updates only Formula/envctl.rb from the exact published version/assets and does not commit or push.

checklist.name: Pinned signed commit action
checklist.description: planetscale/ghcommit-action is pinned to a full commit SHA with an exact version comment and receives the App token.

checklist.name: Commit path boundary
checklist.description: The signed commit action's file pattern is restricted to Formula/envctl.rb on the tap's main branch.

checklist.name: No unsigned escape
checklist.description: There is no ordinary git commit/push, custom author/committer identity, or generator-owned final commit.

checklist.name: Signature readback
checklist.description: The workflow reads the tap default-branch commit, requires verification.verified: true, and proves the formula version/digests match the immutable release.

checklist.name: Setup contract
checklist.description: SETUP.md documents RELEASE_APP_CLIENT_ID, RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, the tap-only token scope, and Contents write.

checklist.name: No broad credential
checklist.description: No classic PAT or long-lived organization-wide tap token is recommended.
